body.title: docs: add practical examples for advanced SQL operators in README
body.body: ## Summary This PR enhances the README by adding practical, beginner-friendly examples for advanced SQL operators to improve documentation clarity and real-world usability. Closes #86 <!-- Link related issues with "Closes #123" or "Fixes #456" --> ### What Changed? Added multiple practical examples for: - LIKE with different wildcard patterns (%, _) - IN with different value types - BETWEEN with numeric ranges - ORDER BY with multiple columns - Combined advanced queries using multiple operators together Used sql markdown code blocks to properly format and display all query examples Ensured examples follow existing README style and formatting ### Why?
